dimensions.label: B1 Escape: Here, you can escape the pressures of daily life and work temporarily

B3 Escape: I can relax without thinking about my responsibilities and obligations here
E1 Extent: All the elements here are interconnected
E2 Extent: The elements here belong to this place
E3 Extent: The entire environment here is highly harmonious
F1 Fascination: Here, there are many places worth exploring
F2 Fascination: Here, many things pique your curiosity
F3 Fascination: Here, many things attract you
F4 Fascination: Here, many things make you linger and reluctant to leave
F5 Fascination: You feel yourself blending into the surrounding environment
C1 Compatibility: The environment here allows you to do what you enjoy
C2 Compatibility: Here, you can solve all the problems that arise
C3 Compatibility: You can adapt to this environment quickly
C4 Compatibility: In this environment, you have things you enjoy doing

Street images: Shanghai Huangpu, Baidu street view (© Baidu). Scale from Lei, Li, Tian, Hu & Jiang (2025), Scientific Reports 15, doi:10.1038/s41598-025-02841-y.

config.description: Method replication: the images are new Baidu street views of Huangpu District, Shanghai (one of four directions at each point), not the paper's 492 images. Participants look at each street view for at least 10 seconds and rate how well each statement of the revised Restorative Components Scale (escape, extent, fascination, compatibility; items B1–C4 as printed in the paper's Table 1) matches their perception, from 1 to 5, as in Lei, Li, Tian, Hu & Jiang (2025, Scientific Reports). Age groups (18–28, 29–50, over 50) and gender are recorded as in the paper. Differences from the original study: 10 random views per participant.

paper.title: Measurement of spatial heterogeneity in street restorative perceptions and street refinement design
